name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.53-beta “Paris” (build 55): LitArbi for organisations.
• Installation for all users of a PC from an MSI (Active Directory / Group Policy, Intune, Configuration Manager), with Group Policy templates for updates, licences and the firm's LitArbi Server.
• Enterprise licence keys: set once by Group Policy, or handed out by the firm's LitArbi Server — no lawyer types a key.
• The licence window shows who provides the licence; “Get a licence from my firm’s LitArbi Server…” when your firm offers them.
• Updates can be left to your IT department (notify only) or switched off by policy.
